long_biography.plain_text:
At Kawa Capital, Alexandre Saverin has combined software development with investment risk management. After studying computer science at Cornell, he worked on Motorola’s multimedia-messaging technology and later developed trading software at Horn Eichenwald Investments. That technical background became useful when he and Daniel Ades established their own Florida-based investment firm.

Saverin helped build Kawa’s proprietary trading and monitoring systems while overseeing hedging, portfolio risk and investment opportunities. The firm expanded beyond its original hedge-fund strategy into private credit, property finance and other tailored investment vehicles. He remains its chief risk officer and a director, bringing a software engineer’s perspective to Kawa’s investment decisions.
